tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything: pure white. Never a tinted panel ground.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers only (popovers, sheets, the phone bar). In light mode it is the same white, set off by a rule and a shadow.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Hover wash only. Never a block or panel ground.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections, rows and articles. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule-mid
tokens.usage: Year ticks on the time ruler, fold rules, borders of disabled controls.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and outline buttons, the time ruler's baseline: ≥3:1 on `paper` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The law, headings and facts.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: running heads, captions, dates in lists.

tokens.name: revogado
tokens.usage: Revoked or expired provisions, always with the word.

tokens.name: verde
tokens.usage: The one accent (verde-garrafa): links and "you are here" (the current tab, the redação on screen). The only solid button uses it.

tokens.name: verde-soft
tokens.usage: Rare quiet fill behind the selected row of a list. Pair with `verde` or `ink` text.

tokens.name: on-verde
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `verde` fill.

tokens.name: ins-ink
tokens.usage: Text that a change ADDED, always with an underline. Reserved for change.

tokens.name: ins-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind added text.

tokens.name: del-ink
tokens.usage: Text that a change REMOVED, always struck through. Reserved for change.

tokens.name: del-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind removed text.

tokens.name: pendente
tokens.usage: Law in the making and redações not yet in force, always with a dashed line or the word.

tokens.name: pendente-bg
tokens.usage: Rare fill behind pending text.

tokens.name: aviso
tokens.usage: The word "Atenção" and warning text.

tokens.name: aviso-rule
tokens.usage: The 3px rule beside a warning and the margin marks it points to.

tokens.name: aviso-bg
tokens.usage: Rare fill for a warning that must stand out from the text (not verified data).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ink outline at 2px offset, never blue, so it never reads as a change.

tokens.name: act-0
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: the original text, a neutral band.

tokens.name: act-1
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: first amending act. 3px band beside the act's name only.

tokens.name: act-2
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: second act.

tokens.name: act-3
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: third act.

tokens.name: act-4
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: fourth act.

tokens.name: act-5
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: fifth act.

tokens.name: act-6
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: sixth act.

tokens.name: act-7
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: seventh act, and older acts grouped.

families.serif: "Source Serif 4", "Source Serif Pro", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Diploma title on its page, once per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Article number in the article view. Phone: 30/34.

styles.name: epigrafe
styles.usage: The epígrafe on the line under the article number, as in the Diário da República. Phone: 26/32.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section heads under the text: Notas, Fonte, Citar, Passagem.

styles.name: status
styles.sample: Redação dada pela Lei n.º 64/2025, de 7 de novembro
styles.usage: The status line: the citation formula and the period in force.

styles.name: statute
styles.sample: 1 — A taxa do IRC é de 17 %, exceto nos casos previstos nos números seguintes.
styles.usage: The law. Measure 64ch, números hang 46px. Phone: 18/28.

styles.name: register
styles.usage: The register of redações and other ruled lists of facts. Lining tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Escolha uma frase para ver a origem do texto.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Código do IRC · Capítulo IV — Taxas
styles.usage: Running heads, captions, labels. Never uppercase.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: ELI paths, hashes, API fields. Professionals only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a mark and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; between alíneas (6px in the law).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows of a ruled list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; between números (15px in the law).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between the title block and the ruler.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between the text column and the register.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Change tints, controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and outline buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: popovers, sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Floating layers only. Nothing on the page has a shadow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Width of the statute column.

tokens.name: hang
tokens.usage: How far números hang into the margin.

tokens.name: hang-al
tokens.usage: Extra hang for alíneas.

tokens.name: register
tokens.usage: Width of the register column.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Height of the one sticky row.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Width of origin bands and warning rules.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on phone.
